title: Enemies won't use weapon restricted skills

posts.author: JackDouble21
posts.body:
Only plugin I've been using is WeaponAnimationSkill by Caethyril (old and updated versions) and at one moment for some reason enemies stopped using any skill which has a weapon restriction on it (I use a lot of common skills between player and enemies). It's the only factor that matters. If the skill has something other than "Nothing" set in the weapon prerequisites window, enemies will never use it. If enemies only have such skills, the game will crash (TypeError : cannot read property meta of null)(Only with old version of WeaponAnimationSkill) or the enemy will just instantly skip their turn (updated version of the plugin or full vanilla MV).
To be clear, I'm a bit unexperienced with RPG maker and it could be a stupid mistake on my part that I'm not aware of (a hidden secret setting, maybe modifying plugins in a project is a no-go idk)
Verifying game files did nothing.
This really bothers me so if anybody has an idea of what it could be it would be of a great help !

the thing is that enemies are programmed to ignore the weapon restrictions placed on skills because they do not have weapons by default. If enemies are respecting weapon restrictions, then its likely that either the core scripts were altered or you do have a plugin to make that change. neither version of Cae's plugin linked makes such a change.
if you open up the objects.js file in the js folder of your project, what version does it say across the top and how many total lines does it have?
Its also worth noting that plugin changes made in the plugin manager dont actually take place until you save your project. so if you had a plugin that makes that change enabled and you turned it off but didnt save, itd still be running

these 2 werent really going to be relevant. when you verify the integrity of MV or uninstall it, it refers to the rpgmaker editor program itself. it doesnt actually do anything for any game you make with it.
SInce youve already reinstalled it, make a fresh project, see if the issue still persists, and if it doesnt, overwrite all the core js files in your current project with those from the fresh one
